facts.fact: Umbra 引路：Quintus（第三日落与首日升起之间、magenta 微光）；影球钻帐蹭他——昨日尸堆时 Umbra 藏身偷听——「由此确认：Taesia 杀哨探是为保护他们；她已拿到过 ward 之法，将潜入 Divine City」；Shadow Sea 边缘立着「至少一打 talpascor 的巨骨（半被暗影啃食、日晒漂白）」——骨镯与残骨共振
facts.anchor: giant skeletons of at least a dozen talpascor

facts.fact: 骨林真相：Taesia 揭「Phos 能培育不止一种士兵：Nyx 灼沙之击本应蔓延到底——Phos 把自己的意识灌入这些兽、迫它们造光墙挡暗——He's always been eager to sacrifice his own」
facts.anchor: He’s always been eager to sacrifice his own.

facts.fact: 劝与拒：她现身「像恐怖与幻想的结合——gaunt 的脸、双星系之眼、real and nonexistent——a victim of her own mythology」；劝退「Get Nik and Rian as far from me as possible. Nyx wants me to kill them——鉴于你是什么，他也许也要杀你」；「You don't answer to anyone. Least of all a god.」——旧式 scything grin；「I may have one more imperator to take from Phos」「Ulshära isn't your enemy. She's on our side.」「That doesn't mean Phos won't use her. Or Nik, or Rian, or whatever hapless zealot crosses his path.」；影指扣颚「stay away from the Divine City. From me.」
facts.anchor: a victim of her own mythology.

facts.fact: 「Instead of you」：他求同行——她「Of course I have to do this alone. 诸神夜我劝大家合作、救 Dante——没人站在我这边。Look at what I've become.」；「I am everything they worried I was. 证明他们对了，比证明他们错了容易得多。Better, in the end, that I become the monster instead of them. Instead of you.」；「星屑烙上他的皮肤——celestial brand——把他标成『属于夜的存在——如果他敢放下童年的怕』」；他答「We've all become monstrous……你说过同时是两样东西并不可耻；你或出于复仇暴怒、但也是为护我们」「若你手上有血我来洗、灵魂有裂我用我的补。I know you. 你不想独自一人——而你也不该」——影如心跳收缩、呼吸同步、她眼中星云暂退

Nikolas 破局：光弹袭来——「Did you lure him here? Make him promises you have no intention of keeping?」；她「You know me. Ever the liar.」；Julian 隔开「amazed a broken heart could beat so fast」；「We need her.」「For Ulshära's support.」——Taesia「Or you can let me take her out of the equation altogether. One less obstacle.」；「Strike down whoever you think deserves it, and fuck anyone who ever cared about them? 你试着杀 Rian 时也这么想？」；「Did you see his son's face, Taesia? Did you see that boy's face after you struck his father down?」「I saw,」她耳语；「Varrick was never going to let you close enough to Phos……His choices were to die then or die later, so I made the decision for him. But you know something of that, don't you?」
facts.anchor: Did you see his son’s face, Taesia?

facts.fact: 兄妹相搏与蜕变：决斗如「多年前排练过的舞」；Rian 空降报「Note to self——new ability limited to three people」「We couldn't stop him——像有什么攫住了他」；Nikolas 光环「并非来自翅膀」、talpascor 骨发光；「Would a third be able to stop them? Orsus 对此 delight 高涨」；Rian 烟花弹暂阻「Stop! Taesia, look. I'm fine. I'm alive.」「You won't be for long if you stay. Nyx wants you both dead.」；Fin 抓臂「Please, look at me.」——不理——颈面爆羽、金翼闪灭；「feral sound——撞开两人、以受困野兽的执念扑向 Taesia」——她惊「What—? Is the spear doing this to you?」——被击飞、捂面血渗
facts.anchor: new ability limited to three people.

facts.fact: 「Stab me through the heart」：眼罩打落——窝内「小小的发光球体」长成；lightspeed 近身抓 Starfell 刃「Then try it. Stab me through the heart the way you stabbed him. Let it be the last cruelty you give me.」——她眼中世界崩塌的恐惧（不是为自己是为他）；Julian 再次 perceive Nikolas 的心智（如 Bone Palace 把他从 Phos 手中拽出时）；她双手握剑——「Nikolas 背后衬衫撕裂、两截血肉残桩自肩胛升起」「Fuck. Nik. Stay with me, don't let him—」
facts.anchor: Stab me through the heart the way you stabbed him.

facts.fact: 白翼破背与神夺身：Julian 以恶魔之力压制（弃 Orsus）——金瞳、窝内 glare、羽刺静电、獠牙渐长；beastspeaking 探其心智遭「尖锐反击」；Nikolas 呕出湿血羽、爬向矛——Rian 夺矛、Fin 按其肩胛隆起——「agonized scream——两扇白色巨翼破背而出」（血溅、Rian 面上红雀斑、Edwin 停笔）；Taesia 如泣「This is what I was trying to—What I didn't—Fuck. This ends now.」——影聚、「门户如 sore 般渗开」；Orsus「Then use your gifts. Not your curse.」——Julian 抓 Rian 手追画（一线一弧一点——「More.」「Do you see how the world can be shaped with your touch?」）；「神的在场像霉斑扎进地基；恶魔退让」；「Or you can end this. Just you. Just us.」——口角见血；穿门封线——Orsus 不退「You will need my help for what is to come.」；广场=十个 Nexus 街区、大地嗡鸣；Taesia 刺指绘「八线圆——the same glyph Edwin had shown them」；Rian 望向巨柱神殿——「The Divine City,」Rian whispered.
facts.anchor: two gory stumps rose from his shoulder blades.
